create_optax_trace: create an optax trace gradient transformation with decay rate and optional Nesterov momentum
create_optax_ema: create an optax exponential moving average gradient transformation with decay and optional debiasing
create_multi_steps: create a MultiSteps optimizer wrapper that accumulates gradients over multiple mini-steps before applying updates
use_skip_not_finite: use skip_not_finite to reject gradient updates containing inf or NaN values
use_skip_large_updates: use skip_large_updates to reject gradient updates whose squared norm exceeds a specified threshold
